environment.description: Production deployment in namespace ci-cd-prod. LaunchDarkly project 'cicd-platform' has flag 'enable-metadata-passthrough' configured with targeting OFF and default variation index 0 (false). Flag was last modified 2024-01-15 with kill switch engaged after security review SR-2847. The LD SDK is initialized with server-side SDK key 'sdk-prod-a8f2c...' connecting to LaunchDarkly Relay Proxy (ldrelay v7.1) running in the same cluster with persistent feature store backed by DynamoDB table 'ld-features-prod'. The relay proxy has a 30-second polling interval and the DynamoDB table has point-in-time recovery enabled. Note: the flag evaluation context uses a static key 'pipeline-orchestrator' which matches the kill switch rule targeting all contexts. The SDK is configured with offline=false and send_events=true, confirming active connection to the relay.
